source_text: A total of one hundred and fifteen (115) mosquitoes from Auyo... were successfully pyrosequenced simultaneously for both West-kdr (L1014F) and East-kdr (L1014S)... The L1014S-kdr mutation was detected in a single An. arabiensis mosquito while no ace-1R mutation was found in any of the mosquitoes analysed.
One An. arabiensis individual was found to be heterozygote for the L1014S-kdr mutation and homozygote susceptible (A/A) for L1014F-kdr.
